//go:build acceptance

package acceptance_test

import (
 "encoding/json"
 "os"
 "os/exec"
 "path/filepath"
 "testing"
)

// TEST ONLY: reuse the pinned native fixture, not a second lifecycle builder.
type farmboy025ReadyStop struct{}

func TestFarmboy025Composition(t *testing.T) {
 defer func(){ if r:=recover(); r!=nil { if _,ok:=r.(farmboy025ReadyStop); !ok {panic(r)} } }()
 ran := false
 featureDeliveryProof(t, "FBTEST", nil, func(f deliveryProofFixture) {
  v := f.selected()
  if ran || v.CurrentRun != nil || v.PlanState != "awaiting_plan_review" { return }
  ran = true
  root := t.TempDir()
  data, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"repo":f.repo,"store":f.target,"feature":v.Feature,"current":v})
  if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
  manifest := filepath.Join(root,"fixture.json")
  if err = os.WriteFile(manifest,data,0600); err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  c := exec.Command(os.Getenv("FB025_TEST_PYTHON"), os.Getenv("FB025_TEST_HANDLER"), "--fixture", manifest)
  c.Stdout=os.Stdout; c.Stderr=os.Stderr
  if err=c.Run(); err!=nil { t.Fatal("Farmboy candidate composition",err) }
  // Stop the shared builder at the selected review boundary; unrelated later
  // delivery assertions are outside this fixture. All handler rows passed.
  panic(farmboy025ReadyStop{})
 })
 if !ran {t.Fatal("no review-ready fixture")}
}
